title: Apply for a plant vehicle registration (including forklifts)
summary: Find out how to apply for a plant vehicle registration, including for forklifts, at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
The type of plant vehicle you have will determine if the vehicle requires full or conditional registration:

You can apply for plant vehicle registration at a Service NSW Centre. Please check the conditional vehicle list prior to visiting the service centre, or call 13 77 88.
who_can_apply: The type of plant vehicle determines if the vehicle requires full or conditional registration.
what_you_need: One of the following PDF forms: Application for Registration or Application for Conditional Registration

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: Do I need to know if my vehicle requires full or conditional registration?
faqs.a: Yes, the type of plant vehicle you have will determine if the vehicle requires full or conditional registration.

faqs.q: Where can I apply for plant vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You can apply for plant vehicle registration at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What should I do before visiting a Service NSW Centre?
faqs.a: You should check the conditional vehicle list or call 13 77 88 before visiting the service centre.
